title: Template: the reference setting of the window study
description: Copy this file to start a new experiment: save it as EXPERIMENTS/configs/<new id>.json, set "id" to the same name, change "title", "description" and the values under "changes". As it stands it trains the reference setting: active torque, EMG divided by the session-1 maximum, 200 ms windows with a new one every 10 ms (95 % overlap), LSTM 16 units x 2 layers, trained on session 1 and tested on session 2. Run one person and seed with: python -m EXPERIMENTS.pipeline.run --exp TEMPLATE_reference --subject EG --seed 0. Predictions are written to EXPERIMENTS/results/<id>/<person>/S1toS2/seed<k>.npz with the full settings in the matching .json. Settings not listed under "changes" take the defaults in BASE (EXPERIMENTS/pipeline/settings.py), which also lists the values each setting may take.

settings_help.passive: target: 'static' = measured torque minus the passive torque of the same session's relaxed holds (active torque); 'none' = total measured torque; 'legacy' = the old automatic rule (ML/research/passive.py)
settings_help.metadata_passive: true = IES's passive torque comes from its experiment-metadata table (IES has no relaxed holds)
settings_help.emg: EMG scaling: 'trainmax' = divide by the session-1 maximum; 'train_p99', 'session_p99', 'mvc_global', 'agc_auto' in ML/research/emg_norm.py
settings_help.envelope: 'causal' = forward-only filters (only past EMG, as in a real-time device); 'zerophase' = forward-backward filters
settings_help.lp_order: order of the envelope's low-pass filter
settings_help.trim_end_s: seconds cut from the end of each trial (the first 1 s is always cut)
settings_help.window: time steps per input window; one step = 10 ms x input_step, so 20 = 200 ms
settings_help.input_step: samples between the steps of one window (1 = every 10 ms sample)
settings_help.train_stride: samples between consecutive training windows: 1 = a new window every 10 ms; equal to window = no overlap. Validation and test always use every window
settings_help.val_gap: true = validation starts one window span after the training part of each trial, so no validation window reuses training samples
settings_help.state: 'reset' = LSTM state reset at every window; 'carry' = state carried between windows within a trial
settings_help.shuffle: false = training windows fed in time order
settings_help.balance: 'none' = plain mean-squared error; 'scale' = per-angle loss scaling (ML/research/train.py)
settings_help.train_protocol: 'fast' = batch 64, at most 150 epochs, learning rate x 0.5 after 6 flat epochs, early stop 15; 'fast400' = the same with at most 400 epochs; 'orig' = batch 8, at most 200 epochs, x 0.7 after 10, early stop 25 (ML/research/config.py)
